design: reports/plans/2026-10-20_plan_lora-split.md (design check confirmed by the user 2026-10-20, as recommended)

gates.if_fail: the factor loading or the harness changed; stop and find out
gates.rule: lora24's algebraic pooled outside-both share at the part-2 steps equals E9's (lora_plateau.json pile_steps[step].inexpressible.pooled) within 0.003

gates.if_fail: that step is reported, not scored
gates.rule: harness G2: the least-squares split state's P(o) equals the update's to 1e-3 and the route shares sum to 1 to 1e-6, every part-2 step

predictions.null: write_in ratio >= 1.5 at some step >= 10 (B learned a direction col U writes) or read_in ratio >= 1.5 (A became readable)
predictions.pass: read_in ratio <= 1.2 and write_in ratio <= 1.3 at every step
predictions.predicted: pass: E9's outside-both ratio 0.82-1.02 at every step leaves little room for either side to be well inside

predictions.pass: out_out ratio <= 0.7 at every step from 10 on, and read_in ratio >= 1.3 and write_in ratio >= 1.3 at step 10
predictions.predicted: pass: E8 read 0.27 against 0.53 (0.51) at step 10 under the algebraic share; the trend along steps is the reading

predictions.arm: ft and lora24, every step, pooled over all 24
predictions.null: ft >= 10 x at some step (the update strengthens existing pieces)
predictions.pass: rescaling share <= 3 x its random-draw null for both updates at every step
predictions.predicted: pass: E1 read 0.06% against 0.035% for a fine-tune (1.7 x)

predictions.arm: site rows, every rank and step on h.2.mlp.down_proj
predictions.null: the rank-32 run's ratio differs from the rank-1 run's by more than 0.3 at step 100
predictions.pass: out_out ratio in [0.8, 1.2] for every run and step
predictions.predicted: pass: E7's algebraic shares were 0.38-0.43 against 0.42 at every rank

predictions.arm: the scaled adjoint state, part-2 steps, ft and lora24
predictions.expected: P(o) tracks R: the LoRA's state (R near 1 - out_out, about 0.4) loses the behaviour, the fine-tune's keeps most of it; first reading, no threshold
predictions.reported: held-out P(o) against the update's, the reproduced share R and the scale c per matrix, the standing table

predictions.arm: least-squares split states at the part-2 steps, one card
predictions.null: ft's split <= 1 + 3 f at step 10 (E8's 5.41 was the card) or lora24's > 1 + 3 f at some step
predictions.pass: lora24's Pile PGD ratio <= 1 + 3 f at steps 10, 100 and 1000 and ft's >= 2 at step 10
predictions.predicted: pass: E9 (L40S) 1.26, 1.22, 1.07; E8 and E2 (L40) 5.41; ft at steps 100 and 1000 reported

reported_not_scored: n_half of both splits against the random draws; c and R per matrix; part 2's route split and Delta share; the adjoint state's Delta change (second order in c, expected small); the per-matrix tables; the fine-tune's P(o) and kl_other per step

setup.algebraic: split.weighted_fractions, the standing outside-both share with its null (E2 to E9), for continuity
setup.blocks: split.four_blocks: input-weighted energy of delta-W split by P_U on the write side and, on the read side, by the part of the input predictable from what the alive subcomponents read (a1) against the uncorrelated rest (a2); sums to one; null = exact expectation for an isotropic random update. Pooled by energy over all 24 matrices and over the 20 non-saturated ones (the scored pooling, as E8 and E9)
setup.part2: harness.nothing_and_split and harness.measure of the adjoint state at steps (10, 100, 1000): route split at the trigger, Delta's share of ||delta-W||^2, Pile ratios (256 val rows, 20 PGD steps, W0 floor over adversary seeds (0, 1, 2)); the adjoint state's held-out P(o) against the update's
setup.ratio: a block's pooled share divided by its pooled null; read_in = in_in + out_in, write_in = in_in + in_out
setup.rescaling: split.rescaling_share, the weighted least-squares fit by sum_c alpha_c u_c v_c^T; null = mean over 2 Gaussian draws of the same per-matrix weighted energy
setup.splits: least-squares (split.least_squares_split) and adjoint (split.adjoint_split, scaled per matrix by split.adjoint_scale); n_half = number of subcomponents over all matrices carrying half the summed piece energy (split.piece_energies), against the same for the random draws

updates.ft: emoticon full fine-tune, arm A recipe (Adam lr 3e-05, all 24 matrices, seed 0), delta-W kept at steps (1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000)
updates.lora24: E9's rank-8 LoRA on all 24 matrices, BA from the saved factors at steps (1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 30, 100, 300, 1000)
updates.site: E7's LoRAs ('r1_s0', 'r4_s0', 'r8_s0', 'r32_s0', 'r8_s1') on h.2.mlp.down_proj at steps (10, 30, 100)
